headline: Taiwan Strait escalation or major exercise

items.text: AEI/ISW report China may be running an unannounced exercise simulating the isolation of Taiwan, larger than Justice Mission 2025.
items.why: Taiwan Strait escalation or major exercise

items.text: Taiwan's NSC chief says more than 100 Chinese navy and coast guard vessels are operating in the western Pacific.
